articles.title: Bitcoin could test $90,000 after shorts get squeezed, but traders warn leverage is building
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has broken out to $86,000, but analysts say the next leg depends on whether spot buyers continue to show up as leverage builds.

articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin hits $87,000, while traders pile into leveraged bets
articles.snippet: Crypto majors climbed alongside equity futures on Monday, with Monero's XMR up 13%, as Brent fell for a fourth straight session and traders positioned for Trump-Xi summit later this week.

articles.title: Coinbase, Robinhood, Circle could be early winners of SEC's tokenized-stock push, analysts say
articles.snippet: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the agency's move create new opportunities in custody, tokenization infrastructure and stablecoin settlement, while giving brokers room to expand onchain products.

articles.title: Crypto traders braced for a total wipeout this week but Bitcoin had other plans
articles.snippet: Market experts view bitcoin’s price stability as evidence of its fundamental independence from Washington, maintaining that global liquidity and adoption cycles remain the primary growth drivers.
